aggregate_decision.arm_estimate: mean closed-loop success rate across the three frozen training seeds
aggregate_decision.allocation_regret: highest arm estimate minus the point-prediction estimate
aggregate_decision.all_data_reference: the three opened all-data probe policies

regression_test.risk: mean frozen state-level product of probe failure probability and candidate coverage distance within each candidate-stratum row
regression_test.observed_change: candidate closed-loop success minus all-data probe success on the same frozen states and replicates
regression_test.primary_association: Spearman rank correlation between frozen risk and observed change; the predicted direction is negative
regression_test.tail_contrast: mean observed change in the ten highest-risk rows minus the ten lowest-risk rows; the predicted direction is negative
regression_test.tie_breaking: risk, then candidate id, then numeric stratum

uncertainty.candidate_resampling: resample the three common candidate seed indices jointly across candidate arms
uncertainty.probe_resampling: resample the three probe policy indices independently
